Either retag to 17:13 or replace with a properly-timestamped closing-warmth example. (2) cherry_pick_moments[3] 'Now now I'm looking on Google Maps...' is mis-timestamped at 01:49 — it actually occurs at [01:25]; retag to 01:25 (note this same quote is correctly used at 01:25 elsewhere in trajectory_verdict.grounded_examples, so this is simply a duplicate-use timestamp slip). Reclassify cherry_pick_moments[2]'s label from 'curiosity_creation_failure' to something aligned with its own bill_anchoring schema_reference. Strengthen the button_up cherry_pick_moment's coaching_implication — the missing no-driving/computer instruction and 'is that fair?' handshake are hard_required schema elements entirely absent, not just channel-ambiguous; don't let the alternative_hypothesis fully excuse this. Optionally run schema_drift_detection explicitly on the 670 credit threshold since the schema flags this as an active tracked drift pattern.
